upstream.description: Fara1.5 – A family of frontier computer use agent models

classification.analysis: Fara1.5 is Microsoft Research's family of native computer-use agent models (4B/9B/27B, built on Qwen3.5) that operate a browser directly from screenshots — clicking, typing, and scrolling via predicted coordinates without accessibility trees. It's aimed at researchers and developers building autonomous web-task agents (form filling, shopping, bookings, research), and ships open weights on Hugging Face, an eval harness (WebTailBench, Online-Mind2Web), and a Playwright-based execution environment. It's designed to be used standalone via `fara-cli` or inside Microsoft's Magentic-UI for sandboxed, audited browser automation.

use_cases.title: Automate multi-step web tasks with a local computer-use model
Benchmark a web agent against WebVoyager or Online-Mind2Web
Run a sandboxed browser agent with audit logging via Magentic-UI
